Standard: Following an abrupt maximum pitch control step input to elevated LFs, the air vehicle LF onset does not result in pilot g-LOC, air vehicle departure, or exceedance of LF limits. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the flying qualities and the susceptibility to pilot g- LOC, departure from controlled flight, or structural exceedances following an abrupt maximum pitch control step input to elevated LFs for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the flying/handling qualities and the susceptibility to pilot g-LOC, departure from controlled flight, or structural exceedances following an abrupt maximum pitch control step input to elevated LFs for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the flying/handling qualities and the susceptibility to pilot g-LOC, departure from controlled flight, or structural exceedances following an abrupt maximum pitch control step input to elevated LFs for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
